name: Wi-Fi Hotspot Lending
description: Forbes Library in Northampton lends Wi-Fi hotspots for 3 weeks, with one renewal. Any Massachusetts resident with a card from a certified Massachusetts library can borrow one. Reserve it like a book through the library catalog, or call the library during business hours.
contact: (413) 587-1011; Forbes Library, 20 West St., Northampton MA 01060

requirements.text: Any Massachusetts resident with a library card from a certified Massachusetts library is eligible to borrow a hotspot. Registration in the library system is required if you don't have a current library card.
Hotspot borrowers must be 17 years or older and in good standing with the library. Only one hotspot per household.
Hotspots may be borrowed for 3 weeks with one renewal. Pick it up within 7 days of a hold. The cost to replace a lost hotspot is $75.

unknowns: Whether there is any fee to borrow is not stated (only the $75 replacement cost).
Library opening hours are not on this page.
How many hotspots are available, or typical wait times, is not stated.

first_step.title: Reserve a Wi-Fi hotspot at Forbes Library
first_step.detail: Place a hold through the Forbes Library catalog, or call (413) 587-1011 during business hours. Bring a Massachusetts library card.
